ai.title: Added Product Hunt launch badge to web homepage
ai.summary: Added a Product Hunt featured badge to the web homepage in `web/src/app/page.tsx`. The badge dynamically adapts to the user's current theme using `useTheme` from `next-themes`. Links to the Manicode launch post with a theme-aware embed URL.

eli5.text: When you visit the homepage, you'll now see a featured badge from Product Hunt prominently displayed below the main content. This badge changes its appearance to match whether the site is in light or dark mode, and clicking it takes you to the Product Hunt page where the product was launched. If you looked at the page today, you'd notice this new visual element that wasn't there before, serving as a recognizable seal of recognition from the developer community platform.

ai.title: Add YC logo to landing page
ai.summary: Replaced text-based YC mention with `y-combinator.svg` in `web/src/app/page.tsx`. Updated hero copy line breaks and standardized agent name to 'Manicode'. Internal repo change.

eli5.text: The landing page now shows the Y Combinator logo image instead of just typing 'Y Combinator' as plain text, so visitors see the recognizable orange-and-white 'YC' symbol right away. The welcome headline also got tidier line breaks to read more smoothly on desktop and mobile. Behind the scenes, the tool's name shown on the page was quietly standardized to 'Manicode' wherever it appears in the description text. If you visited the homepage today, you'd see the official YC logo sitting next to other launch badges like Product Hunt, giving the page a more polished, badge-filled look without changing how the tool itself works.
